name: Who did it?
source:
One of your friends died apparently  commited suicide but you (Jake) know that did not happen. It's up to Jake to show the truth to his friends.

[From [url=https://miguellangeloo.itch.io/who-did-it]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的一位朋友显然是自杀身亡，但你（杰克）知道这并没有发生。杰克有责任向他的朋友们展示真相。

[来自[url=https://miguellangeloo.itch.io/who-did-it]Itch.io[/url]]
